description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class 'MediaPlayerDemo' that provides UI buttons to demonstrate media playback functionalities, such as local and streaming audio/video playback. It sets up buttons with click listeners that launch corresponding activities with intent extras indicating the media type.

classes.name: MediaPlayerDemo
classes.description: An Android Activity that provides a user interface with buttons to demo media playback options including local and streaming audio/video.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and assigns click listeners to buttons for different media types.

methods.name: mLocalAudioListener
methods.description: Handles clicks for the local audio button, starting MediaPlayerDemo_Audio activity with an intent extra indicating local audio.

methods.name: mResourcesAudioListener
methods.description: Handles clicks for the resources audio button, starting MediaPlayerDemo_Audio activity with an intent extra indicating resources audio.

methods.name: mLocalVideoListener
methods.description: Handles clicks for the local video button, starting MediaPlayerDemo_Video activity with an intent extra indicating local video.

methods.name: mStreamVideoListener
methods.description: Handles clicks for the streaming video button, starting MediaPlayerDemo_Video activity with an intent extra indicating stream video.
